options.A: By selecting File > New > Blank document, or by using Ctrl + N in the desktop application
options.B: By selecting File > Open
options.C: By selecting File > Save
options.D: By selecting File > Print

questions.explanation: A user can select File > New > Blank document, or use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + N in the desktop application.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Word, what is the difference between Save and Save As?

options.A: Save updates the current file, while Save As creates a new file or saves the document under a different name, location or format
options.B: Save creates a new file, while Save As updates the current file
options.C: Save and Save As are identical
options.D: Save closes the file, while Save As prints it

questions.explanation: Save updates the current file, while Save As creates a new file or saves the document under a different name, location or format.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Tables, Page Setup, Headers and Footers
questions.question: In Word, what is the purpose of a table of contents?

options.A: It lists document headings and their page numbers, and can be generated and updated automatically when heading styles are applied correctly
options.B: It lists all tables in the document
options.C: It lists all images in the document
options.D: It lists all footnotes in the document

questions.explanation: A table of contents lists document headings and their page numbers. It can be generated and updated automatically when heading styles are applied correctly.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Tables, Page Setup, Headers and Footers
questions.question: In Word, what is a footnote?

options.A: A note or reference placed at the bottom of the page where its reference mark appears
options.B: A note or reference collected at the end of the document or section
options.C: A note placed in the header
options.D: A note placed in the footer

questions.explanation: A footnote is a note or reference placed at the bottom of the page where its reference mark appears.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Tables, Page Setup, Headers and Footers
questions.question: In Word, what is an endnote?

options.A: A note or reference collected at the end of a document or section rather than at the bottom of the page
options.B: A note or reference placed at the bottom of the page
options.C: A note placed in the header
options.D: A note placed in the footer

questions.explanation: An endnote is a note or reference collected at the end of a document or section rather than at the bottom of the page.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Find, Replace, Review and Printing
questions.question: In Word, what is the purpose of comments?

options.A: They are review notes attached to selected text or document locations, allowing reviewers to provide feedback without directly changing the document text
options.B: They are notes placed at the bottom of the page
options.C: They are notes placed at the end of the document
options.D: They are notes placed in the header

questions.explanation: Comments are review notes attached to selected text or document locations, allowing reviewers to provide feedback without directly changing the document text.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Find, Replace, Review and Printing
questions.question: In Word, what is the purpose of PDF export?

options.A: It creates a Portable Document Format copy of a Word document, helping preserve layout for sharing and printing
options.B: It converts a Word document into an Excel workbook
options.C: It converts a Word document into a PowerPoint presentation
options.D: It converts a Word document into an image file

questions.explanation: PDF export creates a Portable Document Format copy of a Word document, helping preserve layout for sharing and printing. The exported PDF is not necessarily intended for ordinary Word editing.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Find, Replace, Review and Printing
questions.question: In Word, what is the difference between printing all pages and printing a page range?

options.A: Printing all pages prints the entire document; printing a page range prints only the specified pages or ranges, such as pages 2-5
options.B: Printing all pages prints only the first page; printing a page range prints all pages
options.C: They are identical
options.D: Printing all pages prints only selected text; printing a page range prints the entire document

questions.explanation: Printing all pages prints the entire document; printing a page range prints only the specified pages or ranges, such as pages 2-5.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Word, what does Format Painter copy?

options.A: It copies formatting from selected text or an object and applies it to another selection without copying the content
options.B: It copies the selected text content
options.C: It deletes the selected text
options.D: It changes the page layout

questions.explanation: Format Painter copies formatting from selected text or an object and applies it to another selection without copying the original content.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Word, what is a drop cap used for?

options.A: It is an enlarged initial letter at the beginning of a paragraph, often extending down multiple lines
options.B: It is a type of bullet
options.C: It is a page header
options.D: It is a footnote

questions.explanation: A drop cap is an enlarged initial letter at the beginning of a paragraph, often extending down multiple lines.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Word, what is a watermark commonly used for?

options.A: It is often used to mark a document as Draft, Confidential or Sample
options.B: It is used to add page numbers
options.C: It is used to create a table of contents
options.D: It is used to insert footnotes

questions.explanation: A watermark is text or an image displayed behind document content, often used to mark a document as Draft, Confidential or Sample.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Tables, Page Setup, Headers and Footers
questions.question: In Word, what is the purpose of AutoFit in tables?

options.A: It adjusts table column widths or the table's overall width according to contents or available page space
options.B: It automatically formats the table with a specific style
options.C: It automatically inserts a new table
options.D: It automatically deletes empty rows

questions.explanation: AutoFit adjusts table column widths or the table's overall width according to contents or available page space.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Tables, Page Setup, Headers and Footers
questions.question: In Word, what is the purpose of Different First Page?

options.A: It allows the first page of a section to have a different header and footer from the remaining pages in that section
options.B: It allows the first page to have a different font size
options.C: It allows the first page to have a different page orientation
options.D: It allows the first page to have a different margin size

questions.explanation: Different First Page allows the first page of a section to have a different header and footer from the remaining pages in that section.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Word Tables, Page Setup, Headers and Footers
questions.question: In Word, what does Link to Previous do in headers and footers?

options.A: It connects a section's header or footer to the corresponding one in the previous section, so changes may be shared
options.B: It links the header to the footer
options.C: It links the document to an external file
options.D: It links the header to the table of contents

questions.explanation: Link to Previous connects a section's header or footer to the corresponding one in the previous section, so changes may be shared. Turning it off allows independent content.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Excel Data Entry, Formatting and Formulas
questions.question: In Excel, what is the purpose of conditional formatting?

options.A: It automatically changes the appearance of cells when specified rules or conditions are met, helping users identify patterns, values and exceptions
options.B: It automatically changes the formula in a cell
options.C: It automatically changes the worksheet name
options.D: It automatically creates a chart

questions.explanation: Conditional Formatting automatically changes the appearance of cells when specified rules or conditions are met, helping users identify patterns, values and exceptions.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Excel Data Entry, Formatting and Formulas
questions.question: In Excel, what is the purpose of data validation in data analysis?

options.A: It helps maintain data quality by restricting entries to allowed values or conditions, reducing inconsistent or invalid input
options.B: It helps create charts from data
options.C: It helps sort data
options.D: It helps filter data

questions.explanation: Data Validation helps maintain data quality by restricting entries to allowed values or conditions, reducing inconsistent or invalid input.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: Excel Data Entry, Formatting and Formulas
questions.question: In Excel, what does percentage formatting do to the value 0.25?

options.A: It displays it as 25%
options.B: It displays it as 0.25%
options.C: It displays it as 2.5%
options.D: It displays it as 250%

questions.explanation: Percentage formatting displays a numeric value as a percentage by multiplying its displayed value by 100 and adding the percent sign. For example, 0.25 is displayed as 25%.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the AND function return?

options.A: TRUE if all supplied logical conditions are TRUE; otherwise FALSE
options.B: TRUE if at least one supplied logical condition is TRUE
options.C: The reverse of a logical value
options.D: The sum of the supplied values

questions.explanation: AND returns TRUE if all supplied logical conditions are TRUE; otherwise it returns FALSE.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the VLOOKUP function do?

options.A: It searches for a value in the first column of a table or range and returns a value from a specified column in the same row
options.B: It searches for a value in the first row of a table and returns a value from a specified row
options.C: It searches a range or array and returns a corresponding value from another range or array
options.D: It joins text from multiple cells

questions.explanation: VLOOKUP searches for a value in the first column of a table or range and returns a value from a specified column in the same row. Its traditional exact-match form uses FALSE as the final argument.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the CONCAT function do?

options.A: It joins text from multiple cells or text strings into one text string
options.B: It splits text into multiple cells
options.C: It converts text to uppercase
options.D: It counts characters in a text string

questions.explanation: CONCAT joins text from multiple cells or text strings into one text string.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the LEN function return?

options.A: The number of characters in a text string, including spaces
options.B: The first character of a text string
options.C: The last character of a text string
options.D: The text converted to uppercase

questions.explanation: LEN returns the number of characters in a text string, including spaces.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the UPPER function do?

options.A: It converts text to uppercase letters
options.B: It converts text to lowercase letters
options.C: It capitalises the first letter of each word
options.D: It removes spaces from text

questions.explanation: UPPER converts text to uppercase letters.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the LOWER function do?

options.A: It converts text to lowercase letters
options.B: It converts text to uppercase letters
options.C: It capitalises the first letter of each word
options.D: It removes spaces from text

questions.explanation: LOWER converts text to lowercase letters.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the LEFT function return?

options.A: A specified number of characters from the beginning of a text string
options.B: A specified number of characters from the end of a text string
options.C: A specified number of characters from the middle of a text string
options.D: The number of characters in a text string

questions.explanation: LEFT returns a specified number of characters from the beginning of a text string.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Excel, what does the RIGHT function return?

options.A: A specified number of characters from the end of a text string
options.B: A specified number of characters from the beginning of a text string
options.C: A specified number of characters from the middle of a text string
options.D: The number of characters in a text string

questions.explanation: RIGHT returns a specified number of characters from the end of a text string.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In PowerPoint, what does WordArt do?

options.A: It is a text-formatting feature that applies decorative styles and effects to text
options.B: It inserts images
options.C: It inserts charts
options.D: It inserts tables

questions.explanation: WordArt is a text-formatting feature that applies decorative styles and effects to text.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In PowerPoint, what is a shape?

options.A: A drawing object, such as a rectangle, circle, arrow, line or callout, that can be inserted and formatted on a slide
options.B: A type of animation
options.C: A type of transition
options.D: A type of slide layout

questions.explanation: A shape is a drawing object, such as a rectangle, circle, arrow, line or callout, that can be inserted and formatted on a slide.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In PowerPoint, what is a text box used for?

options.A: It is an object that allows users to place and format text independently on a slide
options.B: It is a placeholder for images
options.C: It is a placeholder for charts
options.D: It is a placeholder for tables

questions.explanation: A text box is an object that allows users to place and format text independently on a slide.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In PowerPoint, what is background formatting used for?

options.A: It changes the slide's background colour, gradient, picture, texture or pattern
options.B: It changes the slide's font
options.C: It changes the slide's transition
options.D: It changes the slide's animation

questions.explanation: Background formatting changes the slide's background colour, gradient, picture, texture or pattern.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: PowerPoint Presentation Delivery, Printing and Shortcuts
questions.question: In PowerPoint, what is the purpose of printing handouts?

options.A: It places multiple slides, often with space for notes, on each page for audience use or presenter reference
options.B: It prints only the speaker notes
options.C: It prints only the title slide
options.D: It prints the Slide Master

questions.explanation: Printing handouts places multiple slides, often with space for notes, on each page for audience use or presenter reference.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.chapter: PowerPoint Presentation Delivery, Printing and Shortcuts
questions.question: In PowerPoint, what does Notes Pages printing produce?

options.A: A page containing a slide and its associated speaker notes
options.B: A page containing only speaker notes
options.C: A page containing multiple slides without notes
options.D: A page containing only the title slide

questions.explanation: Notes Pages printing produces a page containing a slide and its associated speaker notes.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.topic: Important Office File Formats and Exam Revision
questions.question: What is the shortcut for Find in Word, and what is the shortcut for Replace in Word?

options.A: Ctrl + F for Find and Ctrl + H for Replace
options.B: Ctrl + H for Find and Ctrl + F for Replace
options.C: Ctrl + P for Find and Ctrl + S for Replace
options.D: Ctrl + N for Find and Ctrl + O for Replace

questions.explanation: Ctrl + F opens the Find or Navigation Pane search feature in Word, and Ctrl + H opens the Find and Replace interface in Word.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.topic: Important Office File Formats and Exam Revision
questions.question: What is the shortcut for centre alignment, left alignment, right alignment and justified alignment in Word respectively?

options.A: Ctrl + E, Ctrl + L, Ctrl + R and Ctrl + J
options.B: Ctrl + L, Ctrl + E, Ctrl + J and Ctrl + R
options.C: Ctrl + J, Ctrl + R, Ctrl + E and Ctrl + L
options.D: Ctrl + R, Ctrl + J, Ctrl + L and Ctrl + E

questions.explanation: Ctrl + E centres the current paragraph or selected paragraphs, Ctrl + L left-aligns, Ctrl + R right-aligns and Ctrl + J justifies.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.topic: Important Office File Formats and Exam Revision
questions.question: What is the shortcut for saving, printing, creating a new document and opening an existing document in Office applications respectively?

options.A: Ctrl + S, Ctrl + P, Ctrl + N and Ctrl + O
options.B: Ctrl + P, Ctrl + S, Ctrl + O and Ctrl + N
options.C: Ctrl + N, Ctrl + O, Ctrl + S and Ctrl + P
options.D: Ctrl + O, Ctrl + N, Ctrl + P and Ctrl + S

questions.explanation: Ctrl + S saves the current file, Ctrl + P opens the Print interface, Ctrl + N creates a new document, workbook or presentation, and Ctrl + O opens an existing file.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.topic: Important Office File Formats and Exam Revision
questions.question: What is the shortcut for copying, cutting, pasting, undoing and redoing in Office applications respectively?

options.A: Ctrl + C, Ctrl + X, Ctrl + V, Ctrl + Z and Ctrl + Y
options.B: Ctrl + X, Ctrl + C, Ctrl + Z, Ctrl + V and Ctrl + Y
options.C: Ctrl + V, Ctrl + Z, Ctrl + C, Ctrl + X and Ctrl + Y
options.D: Ctrl + Z, Ctrl + Y, Ctrl + C, Ctrl + X and Ctrl + V

questions.explanation: Ctrl + C copies selected content, Ctrl + X cuts selected content, Ctrl + V pastes Clipboard content, Ctrl + Z undoes the most recent supported action and Ctrl + Y commonly redoes or repeats an action.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.topic: Important Office File Formats and Exam Revision
questions.question: What is the shortcut for bold, italic and underline in Word respectively?

options.A: Ctrl + B, Ctrl + I and Ctrl + U
options.B: Ctrl + I, Ctrl + B and Ctrl + U
options.C: Ctrl + U, Ctrl + I and Ctrl + B
options.D: Ctrl + B, Ctrl + U and Ctrl + I

questions.explanation: Ctrl + B applies or removes bold, Ctrl + I applies or removes italic, and Ctrl + U applies or removes underline.
